subject: Initiate AWS ACE registration & PDM/PSM intro — HealthLytics opportunity
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: Sara Jenkins <sara.jenkins@healthlytics.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-30T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Initiate AWS ACE registration & PDM/PSM intro — HealthLytics opportunity

Hi Sara,

Thanks again for the demo last week — great conversation and clear fit on inference needs for your analytics platform. I wanted to start the AWS ACE registration flow and get a short intro scheduled with the AWS PDM/PSM so we can align on co-sell motion and next steps.

Quick proposed agenda:
- Confirm ACE intake form + opportunity details (attachments)
- PDM/PSM intros and alignment on mutual action plan (MAP)
- Timeline for AWS validation and marketplace listing (high-level)

Attached is a short ACE intake spreadsheet (HealthLytics_ACE_Intake_Form.xlsx) — could you review and fill the shaded fields (deal value, expected go-live, compliance notes) and return by EOD Monday?

Proposed times for a 30-min intro: Tue 12/1 10:00–10:30 PT, Tue 12/1 14:00–14:30 PT, Wed 12/2 09:00–09:30 PT. Are any of those work for you?

I'll loop in our PDM/partner lead internally (Vanessa) — she will own next steps for ACE intake and coordination with AWS.

Thanks,
Alex Martinez
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0132

Attachments: HealthLytics_ACE_Intake_Form.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Sara Jenkins <sara.jenkins@healthlytics.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@aws-partner.amazon.com>
Date: 2026-11-30T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Initiate AWS ACE registration & PDM/PSM intro — HealthLytics opportunity

Alex — thanks, this looks good. I filled out the intake form and attached a couple of procurement notes (RFI_summary.pdf). A few quick clarifying items from my side:
1) Expected contract start: target Jan 15, 2027 — need a procurement kickoff by mid-Dec to hit that.
2) Compliance: we require SOC2 evidence and customer data residency notes (we are US-only).
3) Deal value range: $120k–$180k ARR depending on scale assumptions.

All three Tue slots have conflicts for me except Tue 12/1 14:00–14:30 PT — that works. If Tom (AWS) can make it, great. If not, propose Wed 12/2 09:00–09:30 PT as backup.

Cheers,
Sara Jenkins
Head of Platform | HealthLytics
sara.jenkins@healthlytics.com

Attachments: HealthLytics_ACE_Intake_Form_filled.xlsx, RFI_summary.pdf

Forwarding Sara's reply and intake — tagging internal notes for the meeting:

- AWS PDM: Tom Alvarez (cc'd by Sara) — please confirm availability for Tue 12/1 14:00 PT. If Tom is unavailable, we need an AWS backup contact.
- Compliance ask: SOC2 evidence + data residency note — Alex, please prepare SOC2 whitepaper and an ingestion/dataflow diagram to attach.
- MAP items to align on during intro: procurement timeline, proof points (latency/cost for 1M tokens/day), go-to-market co-sell responsibilities, who will own listing tasks in AWS marketplace.

Action items assigned:
- Alex: upload SOC2 whitepaper + dataflow diagram to the HubSpot deal record before the call.
- Karthik: prepare a 5-min slide on expected performance profile and prelim pricing tiers.
- Vanessa: confirm AWS PDM attendance and own ACE intake submission after the call.

I'll send a calendar invite once Tom confirms.

— Vanessa
